notes: R20 000 salary (the fund RFI base), employee retirement contribution (4001) R4 000, employer contribution 15% of RFI = R3 000. The employer contribution is a taxable fringe benefit (Seventh Schedule para 12D, not fetched) and is deemed paid by the employee, so it adds to remuneration and enters s11F with the employee's own (BRS 4001: "paid and deemed paid by employee"). Remuneration 23 000; cap = lesser of 27.5% x 23 000 = 6 325 and R430 000/12; contributions 4 000 + 3 000 = 7 000, so 6 325 is allowed (the employee's R4 000 alone is under 27.5% x 20 000 = 5 500: it is the combination that binds). Taxable 16 675; x12 = 200 100; tax = 18% x 200 100 = 36 018; less 17 820 = 18 198; /12 = 1516.50. The calculator ignores the employer contribution (EMPLOYER_CONTRIBUTION_NOT_SUPPORTED) and allows the R4 000. RFI is only the fund's contribution base here, never a tax limit; s11F is 27.5% of the greater of remuneration or taxable income. NAMED LIMIT: that the benefit sits in the 27.5% base is by Fourth Schedule "remuneration" and para 12D, not a worked SARS example: MEDIUM confidence. A case where the cap does not bind is deliberately not added: the fringe and the deemed deduction cancel and PAYE is unchanged.
